title: What Is Google TV? Pricing & How It Works
summary: What is Google TV? Learn how it works, available devices, and pricing—plus how it organizes streaming, live TV, and apps in one platform.
body_markdown:
TL;DR


5


Quick Takeaways


What consumers and marketers need to know about Google TV.


1. 1


Google TV unifies streaming apps, live channels, and personalized recommendations.


2. 2


The platform is free, but hardware and subscriptions cost extra.


3. 3


It reaches over 300 million active Google and Android devices.


4. 4


Viewers get 10,000 apps, 800+ free channels, and smart controls.


5. 5


Advertisers gain scalable CTV inventory, targeting, optimization, and measurable performance.
